scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,server,electron -c "cyan,yellow,magenta" "pnpm --filter @ark/web dev" "cd ../.. && pnpm dev:server" "wait-on http://localhost:4001 http://localhost:4000 && pnpm dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron: pnpm --filter @ark/server build && pnpm build && ARK_DEV=1 electron dist/main.js
scripts.package:dir: pnpm --filter @ark/web build && pnpm --filter @ark/server build && pnpm build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.package:mac: pnpm --filter @ark/web build && pnpm --filter @ark/server build && pnpm build && electron-builder --mac --arm64
